يستقبحوا (form X)
# يَسْتَقْبِحُوا (yastaqbiḥū) /jas.taq.bi.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْبَحَ (istaqbaḥa)
# يُسْتَقْبَحُوا (yustaqbaḥū) /jus.taq.ba.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْبَحَ (istaqbaḥa)
